# Distillation certificates for the race model's large generalizing circuits (generated by race_certify.py)

Sample of 30 race fits with test error <= 0.1 but more than 6 gates. 'Own Occam' bounds the predictor by its own circuit; 'certificate' bounds it through a small junta / Fourier-sign circuit that agrees with it on unlabelled inputs (certify.py).
